IRS990.Desc: SUPPORTED ORGANIZATIONS - PROVIDE FUNDS TO THE TYPE III NON-FUNCTIONALLY INTEGRATED SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION; LIONS CLUB OF SAN DIEGO. THE BOARDS COORDINATE TO DIRECT THESE FUNDS TO VARIOUS ORGANIZATIONS IN THE SAN DIEGO AREA INCLUDING SIGHT IMPAIRED PROGRAMS, YOUTH ACTIVITY PROGRAMS, HEARING IMPARIED PROGRAMS AND AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROGRAMS. THESE FUNDS ARE ALSO USED TO PROVIDE SCHOLARSHIPS TO AT-RISK YOUTH IN THE SAN DIEGO AREA.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: THE LIONS CLUB OF SAN DIEGO IS A 501(C)(4) BUT CAN BE SUPPORTED BY A SUPPORTING ORGANIZATION UNDER REG SECTION 1.509(A)-4(K) AND WOULD BE A LINE 10 ORGANIZATION IF IT WERE A 501(C)(3).

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part I, Line 12f: Supported Org Not Named in Organizing Documents
Part IV, Section A, Line 3b: Description Of When and How Organization Made The Determination
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION MAINTAINS A COPY OF THE DETERMINATION LETTER FOR THE SAN DIEGO LIONS CLUB AND ANNUALLY COMPLETES A PRO FORMA SCHEDULE A, PART III TO CONFIRM THAT THE CLUB MEETS THE PUBLIC SUPPORT TEST ON AN ANNUAL BASIS.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section A, Line 3c: Explain What Controls The Organization Put In Place
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO LIONS WELFARE FOUNDATION DICTATES TO WHICH CHARITABLE ORGANIZATIONS THE FUNDS DISTRIBUTED TO LIONS CLUB OF SAN DIEGO WILL PAID. THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION WORKS WITH THE BOARD TO ENSURE ALL FUNDS ARE DISBURSED AS DIRECTED.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section D, Line 3: Role The Organization's Supported Orgs. Played
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF THE LIONS CLUB OF SAN DIEGO COORDINATES WITH THE BOARD OF SAN DIEGO LIONS WELFARE FOUNDATION DIRECTLY AND CONTINUOUSLY ON BOTH INVESTMENT POLICIES AND DIRECTION OF ASSETS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part V, Line 4: Intended uses of the endowment fund.
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: TO SUPPORT DAILY OPERATIONS OF THE ORGANIZATION
